description:
Secure packages and envelopes with custom packaging tape.

Print custom packaging tape that protects your product from theft and tampering. Each roll is made of white reinforced paper tape that cannot be easily removed without leaving any damage. This water-activated adhesive instantly attaches to the carton upon application.

Your item’s safe arrival also comes with an impressive branding opportunity. Design each roll with your logo so customers easily recognize your brand upon receipt. Your logo is printed in a repetitive pattern throughout the tape length to amplify brand recognition and association when your customer opens the package.

Running a business often involves shipping out packages to customers. Send envelopes, boxes, and other important items with peace of mind by using custom printed packaging tape.

Printed packaging tapes contain a water-based adhesive that adds a layer of security to parcels. Also called gummed tape, it is tamper-evident, making it easy for you and your customers to see if the package was opened during transit. 

Deter Tampering With Custom Printed Tape

With a single strip of logo packing tape, you can secure boxes and envelopes in minutes.

The fiberglass reinforcement allows you to seal packages up to 30 lbs. Once the tape is in place, it will be impossible to remove without leaving a trace of tampering.

Your logo or branded design pops up against a white background. Customize how often your logo repeats within the measured space across the tape:

  • 12” can fit your company’s name, especially if it will be printed in legible typography.
  •  6” repeats your logo twice for this length.
  • 4” repeats your logo thrice.
  • 3” repeats the logo four times in this length.
  • 2” will repeat the logo six times.

After selecting your logo’s recurrence, choose the best orientation for your logo. Print it horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, or any angle that best suits your logo.

How to Use Custom Packaging Tape

Personalized packing tapes are easy to apply and require only water to activate the adhesive. Apply water with a wet sponge to the non-printed side, so the paper can bond to the carton or envelope. Alternatively, you can use a tape machine or dispenser to apply the tape to high-volume packages.

For low volume applications, moisten the tape with a wet sponge before sealing it on the box.

High volume applications for several boxes shipped at a time can use a tape dispenser.

Create your custom packaging tape in just a few minutes:

1
Simply upload your logo
2
Choose the repeat length and orientation and we will set it up for you.
3
If you would like to create a step-and-repeat or seamless design from scratch, simply download any of our templates for guidance.

Apply the tape to corrugated boxes and shipping envelopes to elevate the look of your packages. With custom printed gummed paper tape, you can have peace of mind knowing that your packages will arrive safely. Check out our custom printing options today.

Engage Customers With Attractive Gummed Paper Tape

For online businesses, every package delivered is the point of contact with customers. Make this experience memorable with well-designed custom packaging tape. Keep these tips in mind while deciding on the tape’s design and its features:

  • Add a personalized touch. Sending out products that are exclusive deals or availed from a special discount? Print a set of custom packing tape that they can associate with this promo.
  • Match seasonal or promotional messaging. Is it a Mother’s Day or Thanksgiving package? Change your logo up a bit to match the occasion.
  • Keep the colors and other visual elements consistent. While a personalized design distinguishes your brand, the colors, logo, and other elements should be consistent with the rest of your branding. Stick to your usual colors and shapes so that brand association is established and sustained.

Printed gummed paper tapes are made of white reinforced paper, which makes them ideal for printing.  Your logo or artwork will be printed in full color and will be very visible against the white background.  Having your logo and message on your custom tape increases brand exposure.

We've made it very easy for you to order your custom packaging tape.  Simply upload your logo, choose the repeat length and orientation and we will set it up for you.  If you would like to create your own step and repeat or seamless design, you may download our template for guidance.

Apply the tape to corrugated boxes and shipping envelopes to elevate the look of your packages.  With custom printed gummed paper tape, you can have peace of mind knowing that your packages will arrive safely.

 

Custom Packing Tape FAQs

Q.What is gummed paper tape?

A.Gummed paper tape has a water-based chemical adhesive that instantly attaches when applied on a carton. The tape uses capillary action to adhere to the box’s material. It results in a permanent bond that prevents theft due to obvious tampering once removed or cut from the box.

Q.What is the minimum order quantity for custom packaging tape?

A.Quantities are listed according to the number of rolls and their corresponding dimensions. You can order a minimum of one (1) roll with a length of 100 or 300 ft. The largest order quantity is at 12 rolls measuring 3,600 ft.

Q.How will you format my packaging tape?

A.The packaging tape’s format will depend on the logo’s repeat length, logo orientation, and quantity. Different options can be combined to customize your packing tape. The tape’s entire width is 2.75”.

Q.Do you offer clear packaging tape?

A.No, all designs are printed on a white or colored background. We recommend printing on a solid color or a white background to distinguish the tape from the packaging box.
